contact.department: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality (MDEQ) OPCGIS. Hosts county parcel layers

counties.notes: Hinds County (Jackson, pop. 231,000; state capital) parcel layer hosted on MDEQ OPCGIS server. Mississippi DEQ hosts parcel layers for many MS counties under the 'Government' folder on opcgis.deq.state.ms.us. The layer publishes 54 fields: OBJECTID, CAMA, PARNO, ALTPARNO, PPIN, OWNNAME, MAILADD1/2, MCITY1/2, MSTATE1/2, MZIP1/2, SITEADD, SCITY, SSTATE, SZIP, SUBNAME, deed and plat references, assessed values, acreage, ZONING, LEGLDESC and geometry measures. OWNNAME field returns owner name in mixed format. Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns Jackson MS site addresses. The same server also has DeSoto County parcels and other MS county datasets. 2026-09-26: the layer now refuses any query that names its outFields (HTTP 200 carrying error 400 "Failed to execute query.", measured twice each on the enrichment, radius and liveness query shapes) and answers outFields=* with 54 fields, so every UrbanKit query to this service sends outFields=* and the sample query above does the same. Measured the same day with returnCountOnly: MAILADD1, MAILADD2, MCITY1, MSTATE1 and MZIP1 are blank on every one of the layer's 114,814 parcels (0 rows each where the column IS NOT NULL AND <> '', against 114,547 for OWNNAME and 114,514 for SITEADD), so the record lists no mailing field and this county serves owner names and site addresses, not mailing addresses.

DeSoto County (Southaven and Olive Branch; pop. 185,000; Memphis metro south) is Mississippi's fastest-growing county and carries the highest parcel-lookup demand in the state. The Tax Parcels layer sits at index 28 of the DeSoto County Layers MapServer (maps.desotocountyms.gov). 15 confirmed fields: PIN, ACREAGE, FULL_ADDR (site address), OWNER_NAME, SECOND_OWNER (co-owner), OWNER_ADDRESS, CITY, STATE, ZIP_CODE, DEED_BOOK1, DEED_PAGE1, WD_Link (warranty deed hyperlink), Tax_Info (hyperlink to county tax record), and Tax_Map (tax map hyperlink). Owner-name queries confirmed live 2026-05-15; SMITH returns Olive Branch MS addresses. WD_Link and Tax_Info are URL fields that deep-link directly into the county's deed and tax systems -- a convenience not common in Mississippi public layers. DeSoto County's GIS Hub at desotocounty-dcms-gis.hub.arcgis.com provides bulk downloads. The county tax assessor portal at desotocountyms.gov handles exemption and appeal records not surfaced in the REST layer. MIGRATED 2026-06-06: Layer 28 of Layers/MapServer was retired (ArcGIS 404) -- parcels now at CountyWebMap/Tax_Assessors_County_Web_Map/MapServer/29 (84,713 parcels; OWNER_NAME search re-verified live). Deed/tax hyperlink fields from the old layer are not confirmed on the new one.
